annotations.title: Request a handwritten note or personal call by a human

description: Request that a real person handwrites and posts a card or makes a short personal call on behalf of your business (always disclosed, never impersonating anyone). Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 12 per handwritten card incl. postage (DE), EUR 15 per personal call.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

message.description: The message or its key points.

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

sender.description: Business on whose behalf the note or call is made.
